description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named 'Transitions' that demonstrates the use of Android's transition APIs for scene changes and animations. It creates multiple Scene objects from layout resources, manages transitions through a TransitionManager, and includes a method to dynamically resize views with transition animations.

classes.name: Transitions
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating scene transitions using the Transition API, including loading scenes from layout resources and dynamically resizing views with animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up scenes from layout resources, and inflates the transition manager.

methods.name: selectScene
methods.description: Handles user interaction to transition between predefined scenes or perform a dynamic resize transition.

methods.name: setNewSize
methods.description: Dynamically changes the size of a View with a transition animation.
